input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. A whimsical orchestral storybook overture for the title screen of a cosy adventure game. Opens with a celesta and harp flourish like a giant book falling open, then a bright, hummable main theme on flute and clarinet over bouncing pizzicato strings; warm French horns answer, a cheeky bassoon counter-melody, glockenspiel sparkles, light snare and timpani, building to a joyful, heroic full-orchestra statement. Major key, about 112 BPM, playful, warm British fairy-tale charm, polished modern orchestral recording.

Instrumental only, no vocals. Cosy music for a grand old country-house library at night, the home base of a cheerful adventure game. A gentle, curious harpsichord melody over a warm string quartet, soft clarinet and flute phrases, plucked double bass, with a quiet crackling fireplace ambience underneath. Relaxed, homely, a little regal and inquisitive, about 92 BPM, steady even dynamics, no big crescendo and no ending, designed to loop seamlessly as background music.

Instrumental only, no vocals. Jaunty English countryside folk tune for a sunny meadow level in a 3D platform adventure game. A lively fiddle melody, accordion chords, a tin whistle answering phrases, bouncy upright bass, acoustic guitar strumming, light hand percussion, tambourine and foot stomps. Rolling green hills, windmills and thatched cottages; playful, energetic and cheeky, major key, about 126 BPM, constant groove with no intro fade and no ending, loop-friendly game background music.

Instrumental only, no vocals. Airy, magical climbing music for a sky level among giant beanstalk leaves and clouds in a 3D adventure game. Twinkling celesta arpeggios, flowing harp glissandi, soaring legato strings that keep rising upward, a soft flute melody, wordless airy synth-choir pads, light brushed percussion. A feeling of wonder, height and floating castles; hopeful and bright, about 104 BPM, constant motion, no ending, loop-friendly game background music.

Instrumental only, no vocals. Playful candy-forest music with a little spooky mischief for a 3D adventure game level made of gingerbread and sweets. Bouncy pizzicato strings, glockenspiel and music-box twinkles, a cheeky staccato bassoon melody, tiptoeing clarinet, woodblock and triangle, a touch of harpsichord, with occasional minor-key turns like a sweet but slightly sinister fairy-tale cottage. About 116 BPM, steady, no ending, loop-friendly game background music.

Instrumental only, no vocals. Dramatic, mischievous villain battle theme for the boss fight of a cartoon storybook adventure game, against a pompous wolf in a tailcoat on a stormy rooftop. Pounding timpani, heavy brass stabs and a bold swaggering trombone and tuba melody, driving low-string ostinato, snare rolls and cymbal crashes, sly chromatic woodwind runs for theatrical comic menace. Minor key, about 140 BPM, intense but fun, constant energy, no ending, loop-friendly.

Short triumphant orchestral victory fanfare for a storybook adventure game: a timpani roll, bright trumpets and French horns playing a rising heroic motif, sparkling glockenspiel and harp, ending on a big joyful major chord that rings out. Instrumental.

Very short magical treasure-found jingle: a quick rising harp glissando and celesta sparkle that lands on a bright, celebratory major brass and strings chord. Whimsical storybook orchestra. Instrumental.
Very short whimsical orchestral sting for a storybook game menu: a playful pizzicato and clarinet flourish ending on a cheerful bright chord with a tiny glockenspiel ping. Instrumental.
